headline: Clinton order makes further changes to Executive Order 12852, which set up the President's Council on Sustainable Development.
what_it_does: This order changes an earlier order, Executive Order 12852, which had already been amended at least once. Order 12852 created the President's Council on Sustainable Development, an advisory group. The title does not say what was changed, such as the council's makeup or how long it would last.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the President's Council on Sustainable Development
who_it_affects.how: The rules setting up the advisory council they serve on were changed, though the source does not say how.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed November 17, 1995; the exact effective date is not stated in the source.
